digest.component_or_area: Reconcile Bridge monitoring and CloudWatch integration
propositions: GitHub Actions reconcile bridge failures produce zero CloudWatch signal and remain invisible to alarms
Bridge runs on GitHub Actions are not covered by host probe observability.sh metrics
Jira API token outages and similar sustained failures cannot be detected or paged because the bridge lacks failure telemetry
Publishing bridge_run_failures metric (1 on failure, 0 on success) with OIDC-authenticated CloudWatch PutMetricData enables failure detection
New IAM role with narrowly-scoped cloudwatch:PutMetricData permission conditioned on namespace rebar/host allows workflow metric publication without widening existing roles
CloudWatch alarm on bridge_run_failures with period 3600 and threshold 1 detects sustained failures (second failure within an hour) while tolerating transient blips
